tasks.label: Build Analytics (kill old server)
args: $conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8791 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.OwningProcess -and $_.OwningProcess -ne 0 } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($conn) { try { Stop-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess -Force } catch {} }; npm.cmd run build
